title: Get dictionary values as a list
description:
Get the dictionary values as a list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as `dict_values_list(student)`, returning the student dictionary's values as a list.
hints: This mirrors getting the keys, but you want the values attached to each key instead of the keys themselves.
Dictionaries have a method that gives a view of just the values, in the same insertion order as the keys.
Call `student.values()` and wrap the result in `list(...)` before returning it.
expected_behavior: Returns a list containing the dictionary's values, in the same order as their keys were inserted.
explanation: student.values() returns a dict_values view of the dictionary's values, and list() converts that view into a plain list, preserving insertion order.
